cohort: The study assessed the records of 34 women with a mean age of 36.62 years who had Vesico-Vaginal Fistula (VVF).
finding: Vesico-Vaginal Fistula (VVF) commonly occurred after abdominal hysterectomy, difficult vaginal delivery, and instrumental delivery, with VVF repair success significantly influenced by previous interventions, timing of surgery (late repair associated with higher success), and surgical approach (abdominal/laparoscopic giving superior results).
mod_finding: Caesarean section (11.77%), difficult vaginal delivery (32.35%), and instrumental delivery (23.53%) were identified as causes of Vesico-Vaginal Fistula (VVF).
